title: Weekly Markets: Warsh's hawkish turn reorders the September Fed decision and the AI capex trade
summary: Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole speech shifted the Fed debate from when to cut to whether to hike, lifting the implied probability of a September move to 55.7% from 35.4% and pushing short-dated Treasury yields and the dollar higher. Equity reaction split along AI exposure: Nvidia gave back Thursday's post-earnings gains as financing costs rose, while Amazon added roughly $110 billion of market value despite a $7.6 billion free-cash-flow outflow. The September dot-plot will determine if the move is tactical or a tighter-for-longer regime.
